Ikṣvāku
------------------------------------------
Ikṣvāku was the son of वैवस्वत मनु and the founder of the dynasty of kings that ruled from अयोध्या. Śrī राम belonged to this dynasty.
Ikṣvāku had a hundred sons and a daughter named Suvarṇā. Among the sons, Nimi started his own dynasty called ‘Videha’ at मिथिला. He was the ancestor of जनक-Sīradhvaja, the ड़थेर् of सीता, of the रामायण fame.
Ikṣvāku was also the name of a ब्राह्मण. Though he was well-versed in the scriptures, he did not care to teach others but led a glutton’s life. He was ultimately saved by the grace of a sage जाबालि.
